text:
sam_p: quick thread — BigCorp wants a trial with no hard cap for 60d so they can load-test search + embeddings. sales is asking product if we can approve.

 tim_sales: they said pilot is gated on us not cutting them off mid-demo. big strategic customer. they want bursty traffic up to ~300k tokens/day for a few hours.

 olivia_f: from a product/roadmap POV we need a predictable playbook. agreeing to unlimited trial sets a bad precedent. options: soft-cap with warnings, time-limited burst credits, or dedicated short-term capacity.

 nate_m: tech note — giving temporary dedicated capacity is non-trivial (provisioning + cost) but we can implement a soft-cap + automated throttles + mid-trial emergency uplift. low lift: a middleware quota layer that emits events and enforces modes.

 rachel_ops: finance is nervous. we need a guaranteed ceiling. propose: default trial = 50k tokens/day + 200k burst credit pool for the 60d; any use beyond requires LOI or explicit approval and will be billed. also require embedding unit cap.

 sam_p: three concrete patterns to choose from: 1) Soft cap (warn at 80%, throttle at 110%) 2) Burst credits (pre-provision X credits that can be consumed) 3) Pilot dedicated node (charged to sales/discovery budget). pick one?

 tim_sales: sales prefers #2 — burst credits that are donated to the customer for demo only. easier to explain.

 olivia_f: what does #2 mean for UX and billing? we need: UI copy, telemetry, automatic expiration, and a failsafe to flip off access.

 billing_bot: propose billing controls: 
- trial_policy: mode=burst_credits
- daily_base_limit=50000
- burst_pool=200000
- burst_expiry_days=60
- auto_block_on_exhaust=true

 config example: 
```json
{"trial_policy":{"mode":"burst_credits","daily_base_limit":50000,"burst_pool":200000,"burst_expiry_days":60,"auto_block_on_exhaust":true}}
```

 nate_m: implementation notes: middleware will decrement burst_pool first, then track per-day usage. emissions: trial_token_consumed, burst_pool_remaining. ETA: 3 days dev + 1 day QA if prioritized. no runtime changes.

 rachel_ops: finance asks for a hard dollar ceiling for any discretionary pledge. compute worst-case: if they consume 200k embeddings + 2M tokens raw, our cost ~ $Y. I'll run numbers and post before EOD.

 legal_bot: any waiver of fees or free credits needs an addendum: non-transferable, expires at expiry date, liability cap, and we should disallow reselling. I can draft a short rider.

 olivia_f: launch criteria to flip on pilot: 1) dev guardrail code merged 2) UI copy + warning modal approved 3) addendum signed or LOI 4) finance confirms dollar ceiling 5) telemetry dashboard live.

 sam_p: decision: provisional agree to pattern #2 (burst credits) pending finance ceiling and signed LOI/addendum. owners: nate -> prototype guardrail (ETA Wed), legal -> addendum (ETA Tue), finance -> ceiling calc (ETA EOD today), product -> UI copy (ETA Tue).

 tim_sales: I'll get LOI and emphasize expiry and non-transfer terms. thanks all. :thumbsup:

 olivia_f: we'll table dedicated capacity discussion to next quarter unless this becomes recurring.

 sam_p: action items repeated in thread. will follow up with ticket IDs when created.
